prompt: Brandon sits on the third step of a narrow shared stairwell in a rented house, elbows on his knees, head bowed to the phone in his hands, its pale light the only warm thing on his face. A bare bulb on the landing above throws a hard cone of yellow light, and the walls are scuffed magnolia with a row of mismatched coat hooks and a stack of unopened post on the bottom stair. The picture is taken from a lens fixed high in the corner of the ceiling above the landing, looking down and across the stairs, a washed-out, compressed, slightly grainy video frame with muted colour and soft shadows, as if on cheap night-mode sensor footage. Brandon is small in the frame, seen from above. Thanks.
